title_en: Hello, Doctor Anton: A House Call
source_file: 你好，安东医生·出诊记（3-6 岁）.pptx
full_text_zh:
[P1] 你好,安东医生
〔日〕西村敏雄 文／图
出诊记

[P2] 你好，安东医生
〔日〕西村敏雄 文／图 袁秀敏 译
出诊记
安东医生的
动物医院
连环画出版社
2019年·北京

[P3] 安东医生是给动物看病的医生。
在他的医院里，
每天有各种动物来看病。
“医生，我肚子疼！”
“医生，我发烧了！”
安东医生不论多忙，都很有耐心。
所以，动物们都非常喜欢他。

[P4] 有一天，医院的工作结束了，
安东医生正在收拾东西……
“啊——啊——来信了！”
乌鸦送来一封信。
“哎呀，怎么回事？
山羊是不是身体不舒服？”

[P5] 安东医生的
动物医院
安东医生收拾好东西，
准备去山羊家。

[P6] 哐当——哐当——哐当——
安东医生飞快地骑着自行车。
“医生，能帮我看一下吗？”
不知从哪儿传来的声音。
“谁呀？”

[P7] 安东医生仔细一看，
在石头后面有一只大乌龟。
“你怎么了？”
“我和兔子赛跑，把腿扭伤了。”
安东医生从药箱里拿出消炎膏药，
贴在乌龟腿上。
“这样就没问题了。请多保重！”

[P8] 哐当——哐当——哐当——
安东医生继续往前骑。
“医、医生，停，停一下好吗？”
不知从哪儿传来的声音。
“谁呀？”

[P9] 安东医生仔细一看，
在叶子背后有一只变色龙。
“你怎么了？？”
“我想吃虫子，结果……”
“原来如此，想吃虫子，结果被刺扎了舌头呀。”
安东医生从药箱里拿出镊子，把刺拔干净了。
“这样就没问题了。请多保重！”

[P10] 哐当——哐当——哐当——
安东医生继续往前骑。
“好疼——好疼——”
不知从哪儿传来的声音。
“谁呀？”

[P11] 安东医生仔细一看，
树后面有一只猴子在哭。
“你怎么了？”
“我练习爬树时，
从树上摔下来，屁股摔伤了。”
安东医生从药箱里拿出药，
抹在猴子的屁股上。
“这样就没问题了。请多保重！”

[P12] 天越来越黑了。
安东医生加快速度骑着自行车。
哐当——哐当——哐当当——
“山羊的家，在哪儿呢？”
安东医生四处张望着……

[P13] 啊，危险！
喀嚓——砰——
咣当！

[P14] 猴子们正好从这里经过。
“吱——吱——，那儿长着两条腿！”
“谁，谁呀？”

[P15] 嗨哟——嗨哟——
猴子们拉着安东医生的腿，
把他从洞里拔了出来。
“医生，您怎么了？”
“我四处张望的时候，撞到树上，
栽进鼹鼠的洞里了。”
“真糟糕，一定很疼吧。”
“对了，医生，您要去哪里呀？”
“我要去山羊的家。”
“哦，我们一起去吧。”
猴子们给安东医生带路，
一起向山羊家走去。

[P16] 哐当——哐当——哐当——
哐当——哐当——哐当——
这里就是山羊的家。
“太好了，终于到了。”

[P17] 安东医生打开山羊家的门，
“生日快乐，安东医生！”
原来，动物们聚在一起，
要给安东医生庆祝生日呢。
不仅有生日蛋糕，还有生日礼物。
“谢，谢谢大家！”

[P18] 总是忙忙碌碌的安东医生，
把今天是自己生日的事，
忘得一干二净。

[P19] 安东医生在前往山羊家的路上，遇到了那些小动物呢？

[P20] 安东医生在前往山羊家的路上，遇到了哪些小动物呢？
乌龟
蜥蜴
猴子
full_text_en:
[P1] Hello, Dr. Ando
〔Japan〕Toshio Nishimura, Text & Illustrations
House Calls

[P2] Hello, Doctor Anton
[Japan] Toshio Nishimura, Text & Illustrations, Translated by Yuan Xiumin
House Call
Doctor Anton's
Animal Hospital
Lianhuanhua Publishing House
2019, Beijing

[P3] Dr. Anton is a doctor who treats animals.
In his hospital,
every day various animals come to see him.
"Doctor, my stomach hurts!"
"Doctor, I have a fever!"
Dr. Anton is always patient, no matter how busy he is.
That's why all the animals like him very much.

[P4] One day, after the hospital work was done,
Doctor Anton was tidying up things...
"Ah—ah—here comes a letter!"
The crow delivered a letter.
"Oh my, what's wrong?
Is the goat feeling unwell?"

[P5] Dr. Anton's
Animal Hospital
Dr. Anton packed up his things,
and got ready to go to the goat's house.

[P6] Clang—clang—clang—
Doctor Anton rides his bicycle quickly.
"Doctor, can you take a look at me?"
A voice comes from somewhere unknown.
"Who is it?"

[P7] Dr. Anton looked closely and saw a big turtle behind the rocks.
"What's wrong with you?"
"I raced with a rabbit and twisted my leg."
Dr. Anton took some anti-inflammatory ointment from his medical bag and applied it to the turtle's leg.
"Now you'll be fine. Take good care!"

[P8] Clang—clang—clang—
Doctor Anton continued riding forward.
"Doc, doctor, stop, stop for a moment, please?"
A voice came from somewhere unknown.
"Who is it?"

[P9] Dr. Anton looked closely and saw a chameleon behind the leaves.
"What's wrong with you?"
"I wanted to eat a bug, and then..."
"Ah, I see. You wanted to eat a bug, but got your tongue stuck on a thorn."
Dr. Anton took tweezers from his medical bag and removed the thorn.
"Now you'll be fine. Take good care!"

[P10] Clang—clang—clang—
Doctor Anton continued riding forward.
"Ouch—ouch—"
A voice came from somewhere unknown.
"Who's there?"

[P11] Dr. Anton looked closely.
There was a monkey crying behind the tree.
"What's wrong?"
"I was practicing climbing trees,
and I fell down, hurting my bottom."
Dr. Anton took medicine from his medical bag
and applied it to the monkey's bottom.
"Now it's all right. Take good care!"

[P12] It was getting darker and darker.
Doctor Anton sped up on his bicycle.
Clang—clang—clang—
"Where is the goat's house?"
Doctor Anton looked around everywhere...

[P13] Ah, danger!
Crack—bang—
Clang!

[P14] The monkeys happened to pass by here.
"Squeak—squeak—, there's something with two legs over there!"
"Who, who is it?"

[P15] Heave-ho— heave-ho—
Monkeys pull Doctor Anton by his legs,
and pull him out of the hole.
"Doctor, what happened to you?"
"While I was looking around, I hit a tree,
and fell into the mole's hole."
"What a mess, it must hurt a lot."
"By the way, Doctor, where are you going?"
"I'm going to the goat's house."
"Oh, let's go together."
Monkeys lead Doctor Anton,
and head together toward the goat's home.

[P16] Clang—clang—clang—
Clang—clang—clang—
This is the goat's house.
"Great, we've finally arrived."

[P17] Dr. Anton opened the door of the goat's house.
"Happy birthday, Dr. Anton!"
It turned out the animals had gathered together
to celebrate Dr. Anton's birthday.
There was not only a birthday cake, but also birthday gifts.
"Thank you, thank you all!"

[P18] Dr. Anton, who is always busy,
has completely forgotten
that today is his birthday.

[P19] Doctor Anton, on his way to the goat's house, met which small animals?

[P20] Which small animals did Dr. Anton meet on his way to the goat's house?
Turtle
Lizard
Monkey
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本封面，展示了一位骑着蓝色自行车的医生形象，书名为《你好，安东医生 出诊记》，作者为日本的西村敏雄。
[P2] 本页为绘本封面，展示安东医生的动物医院外观，医生从二楼窗户挥手，门前停放着蓝色自行车，旁边立有医院招牌，标明书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。
[P3] 本页描绘了安东医生在动物医院为小猪看病的场景，其他动物如狐狸、猫、松鼠、青蛙和鸡在门口等待，文字介绍了安东医生耐心对待每一位动物患者，因此深受动物们喜爱。
[P4] 安东医生在医院工作结束后收拾东西时，收到乌鸦送来的一封信，信上写着山羊不舒服，他担心地查看信件内容。
[P5] 安东医生收拾好东西，骑着蓝色自行车准备前往山羊家出诊。画面左侧是他的动物医院，右侧是他骑车出发的场景。
[P6] 安东医生骑着蓝色自行车在山间小路上飞快前行，途中听到一个陌生声音请求帮助，他停下询问是谁在说话。
[P7] 安东医生在山间小路上遇到一只受伤的乌龟，乌龟告诉他和兔子赛跑时扭伤了腿，安东医生为它贴上消炎膏药并叮嘱它多保重。
[P8] 安东医生骑着蓝色自行车在山间小路上前行，突然听到一个陌生声音请求帮助，他停下询问是谁在说话。
[P9] 安东医生在山间小路上发现一只被刺扎伤舌头的变色龙，他仔细检查后用镊子帮它拔出刺，并叮嘱它多保重。
[P10] 安东医生骑着蓝色自行车在山间小路上前行，突然听到一声“好疼”，他停下询问是谁在说话，画面中树木间隐约可见小动物的身影。
[P11] 安东医生在山间小路上发现一只受伤的猴子，猴子因爬树摔伤了屁股，安东医生为它涂上药膏并叮嘱它多保重。
[P12] 天色渐暗，安东医生骑着蓝色自行车加快速度，一边骑行一边四处张望，寻找山羊的家。
[P13] 安东医生骑车时撞到树上，自行车也撞坏了，他摔倒在地，发出惊呼和撞击声。
[P14] 安东医生撞树后摔倒在地，自行车倒在一旁，猴子们路过时发现他，惊讶地议论并询问是谁。
[P15] 安东医生撞树后跌入鼹鼠洞，猴子们合力将他拉出，并主动为他带路前往山羊家。
[P16] 安东医生在猴子们的帮助下抵达山羊的家，画面中他骑在乌龟背上，变色龙坐在他肩上，猴子们推着自行车，大家显得十分开心。
[P17] 安东医生到达山羊家，发现动物们正在为他举办生日派对，桌上摆着蛋糕和礼物，他向大家表示感谢。
[P18] 安东医生在动物朋友们为他举办的生日派对上，完全忘记了今天是自己的生日。
[P19] 本页以提问形式回顾安东医生在前往山羊家途中遇到的小动物，画面中安东医生站在蓝色自行车旁，面带微笑。
[P20] 本页以提问形式回顾安东医生在前往山羊家途中遇到的小动物，画面中展示了他与乌龟、蜥蜴和猴子的相遇场景。
